alternatives: ConvMixer (patch embedding, depthwise and pointwise mixing)
design_space.why_material: A different inductive bias could change accuracy per FLOP.

alternatives: auxiliary superclass loss from the CIFAR-100 taxonomy
design_space.why_material: Fine classes share superclass structure that short runs may learn faster through coarse supervision.

alternatives: squentropy (CE plus square loss on wrong classes)
design_space.why_material: The loss shapes gradient magnitude on easy versus hard examples in short runs.
Over-parameterised training-time branches can accelerate convergence at no evaluation cost.

alternatives: progressive deepening: residual branches off early, ramped in later
design_space.why_material: Early steps may not need full depth, and cheaper early steps cut time.
Considered and subsumed: both are linear transforms of 2x2 patches, which PCA whitening already absorbs.

hypotheses.proposition: Progressive deepening lowers time at matched accuracy.
hypotheses.mechanism: Residual branches skipped during the first 30-50% of training and blended in, so early steps cost about a third less per stage.
hypotheses.prediction: Accuracy within 0.1 pp of control at 3-8% lower time.
hypotheses.disconfirming_result: Accuracy drops more than the time saved is worth (about 0.1 pp per 2% time).

hypotheses.proposition: An auxiliary superclass loss raises accuracy at fixed epochs.
hypotheses.mechanism: Coarse labels supply shared gradient signal across related fine classes, speeding representation learning in short runs.
hypotheses.decision_changed: Label representation; adoption is rule-gated pending organiser confirmation that the dataset taxonomy may be hard-coded.

hypotheses.mechanism: Re-parameterised multi-branch convs improve optimisation conditioning.
hypotheses.prediction: Accuracy gain exceeding the ~11% FLOP cost (about +0.5 pp at fixed epochs).

hypotheses.proposition: A ConvMixer family matches the convnet at equal time.
hypotheses.mechanism: Large-kernel depthwise mixing on patches gives global context cheaply.
hypotheses.prediction: Accuracy within 1 pp of control at similar time.
hypotheses.disconfirming_result: Far below control at equal time.

hypotheses.proposition: PolyLoss or squentropy beats smoothed cross-entropy in short runs.
hypotheses.mechanism: Different easy and hard-example weighting of gradients.

hypotheses.proposition: Colour-space or DCT input transforms change accuracy.
hypotheses.disconfirming_result: None: 2x2 PCA whitening already applies an equivalent linear transform to patches.

hypotheses.proposition: Vision transformers or MLP-Mixers suit 8-epoch CIFAR-100.
hypotheses.disconfirming_result: Known data hunger: ViTs need far more epochs or pretraining on CIFAR-sized data.
evidence_needed: Only if R4 suggests token-mixing families are competitive

hypotheses.proposition: In-run self-distillation from the lookahead slow weights improves accuracy per time.
hypotheses.mechanism: Soft targets from an averaged teacher.
hypotheses.prediction: Gain exceeding the extra teacher forward cost (about 30%).
evidence_needed: Only if R2 or R5 show label-softness gains

observations.statement: The T-013 climb converged within one family (airbench-style convnet, Nesterov SGD with lookahead, smoothed cross-entropy): 75.26% over 40 seeds at 8.25 epochs and 5.38 s local proxy; earlier levers varied hyperparameters, schedules and execution rather than representation.

omitted_dimensions.rationale: Single view is fixed by the rules; test-time augmentation and test-time adaptation are banned.

probes.method: One sweep at the converged recipe (8.25 epochs, 10 seeds 1300-1309) with in-sweep control: rep_branch, residual_start 0.3/0.5, PolyLoss-1, squentropy, superclass aux 0.3/1.0, ConvMixer-512/8 k5 p2.
probes.decision_rule: Promote any arm beating control by more than 2 combined SE at equal or lower time (or with time saving exceeding accuracy cost) to a fresh-seed confirmation.
probes.information_gain: Covers five distinct representation mechanisms in one pass.

question: Do representation or learning approaches outside the airbench convnet-SGD-CE family lower time to a 75% single-view CIFAR-100 mean?
synthesis: One pass (S24) tests five distinct representation mechanisms at the converged recipe; colour-space and DCT inputs are subsumed by patch whitening; transformers, MLP-Mixers and self-distillation stay dormant unless S24 shows the related mechanism helps.
